description: Layer 4 of the track: how work repeats until done. Workflows, agent loops, stop rules, schedules and multi-agent systems.
Model calls and tools orchestrated through code paths you define in advance. The model fills in steps; your code decides the order.
A system where the model directs its own steps and tool use in a loop until it reaches a goal or a stop condition.
Umbrella term for both workflows and agents: any system where models and tools work together over several steps.
A rule that ends a loop: a final answer, a step, token, cost or time budget, a stuck detector or a human interrupt.
The module's deliverable: goal, pattern, tools, approval points, budgets, stop rules, durability and failure modes for one product.
